# L'Oréal

> Daily AI-assisted intelligence on L'Oréal Groupe: strategy, brands, M&A, beauty tech, ESG and innovation.

Content is in English. Articles are collected every two hours from public RSS feeds (trade publications and news searches) about the subject above; summaries and the daily briefing are AI-generated, and each item links to its original source.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/loreal/): articles of the last 30 days with the daily briefing
- [Archive](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/loreal/archive/index.html): one page per month, all articles

## Machine-readable

- [Atom feed](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/loreal/feed.xml): 50 latest articles
- [JSON data](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/loreal/data.json): briefing and articles from the last 30 days
- [Sitemap](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/loreal/sitemap.xml)

## Categories

- 🤝 Strategy & M&A
- 💄 Brands & Launches
- 💡 Beauty Tech & ESG
- 📈 Market

## Sources

- [L'Oréal Corporate & M&A (Google News)](https://www.loreal.com): Corporate news, financial results, global strategy, appointments and M&A.
- [L'Oréal Brands (Google News)](https://www.loreal.com/en/our-brands/): Brand campaigns, launches, partnerships and limited editions.
- [L'Oréal Beauty Tech & ESG (Google News)](https://www.loreal.com/en/beauty-science-and-technology/): Beauty tech, AI, green sciences, packaging and ESG commitments.
- [Cosmetics Business](https://www.cosmeticsbusiness.com/): International B2B reference on cosmetics and beauty brands.
- [Premium Beauty News](https://www.premiumbeautynews.com/): Beauty industry news: brands, distribution, supply chain and finance.
- [Glossy](https://www.glossy.co/): Beauty and fashion business: DTC, retail and marketing.
